heading: Definitions
lead: For purposes of sections 2321b and 2314a 1 of this title—

tree.text: “defense article” and “excess defense articles” have the same meanings as given them in subsections (d) and (g), respectively, of section 2403 of this title; and
“foreign country” includes any department, agency, or independent establishment of the foreign country.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: Section 2314a, referred to in text, was repealed by Pub. L. 93–189, § 26(4), Dec. 17, 1973, 87 Stat. 731.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was not enacted as part of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 which comprises this chapter.
